subject: DNL-1001 randomized
body: Hi Sam, DNL-1001 was randomized today after baseline. Screening chem: eGFR 27, ALT 31, AST 28. First dose given in clinic.

subject: Screening labs DNL-1002
body: DNL-1002 randomized yesterday. Screening ALT came back 142 U/L (our ULN is 40), AST 61. PI felt he was otherwise well.

subject: DNL-1003 baseline
body: Randomized DNL-1003 this morning. Slow vital capacity at master screening was 46% predicted, best of 3 trials. Everything else fine.

subject: DNL-1004 onset date
body: Quick question on DNL-1004, randomized last week: going back through his history he first noticed weakness in his right hand in March 2024. Master screening was 2 Oct 2026.

subject: DNL-1005 riluzole
body: DNL-1005 was randomized on Monday. Note his neurologist started riluzole 50 mg BID about two weeks before his master screening visit.

subject: DNL-1006 enrolled
body: We enrolled and randomized DNL-1006 today. She turns 18 next month and her mother co-signed the paperwork.

subject: DNL-1007 history
body: FYI DNL-1007 (randomized Tuesday) mentioned at baseline that she had a seizure in June, about four months ago. Not on any antiepileptic now.

subject: DNL-1008 meds
body: DNL-1008 randomized and dosed today. He had been on carbamazepine for trigeminal neuralgia; he stopped it 5 days ago for the study.

subject: DNL-1009 prior trial
body: DNL-1009 randomized this week. He finished another ALS drug trial about three weeks before his master screening visit; washout of that drug unknown.

subject: DNL-1010
body: Randomized DNL-1010 today. Background: he got an AAV gene therapy for ALS through an expanded access program in 2023.

subject: DNL-1011 oncology history
body: DNL-1011 was randomized Friday. She had breast cancer treated with surgery and radiation two years ago, no recurrence since.

subject: DNL-1012 baseline
body: DNL-1012 randomized today. She is still breastfeeding her 6-month-old and plans to continue.

subject: DNL-1013 Week 2 call
body: The Week 2 telephone visit for DNL-1013 was done on Day 19; we could not reach her earlier.

subject: DNL-1014 Week 24
body: DNL-1014 came in for his Week 24 visit on Day 179 because of a family trip.

subject: DNL-1015 Week 12
body: Week 12 phone visit for DNL-1015 happened on Day 90.

subject: DNL-1016 safety call
body: DNL-1016 finished study drug; we did the follow-up safety call 35 days after his last dose.

subject: DNL-1017 schedule
body: DNL-1017 missed his Week 8 clinic visit entirely and we did not reschedule it; we will see him at Week 16.

subject: DNL-1018 baseline day
body: Baseline for DNL-1018: he took his first dose of study drug at 8 am in clinic, then we did the ECG, vitals and ALSFRS-R afterwards.

subject: DNL-1019 LP
body: DNL-1019 had his baseline lumbar puncture on the 1st and his first dose of study drug on the 11th.

subject: DNL-1020 ATE start
body: DNL-1020 took his first open-label ATE dose on Monday; his Week 24 lumbar puncture was done Tuesday.

subject: DNL-1021 randomization
body: We went ahead and randomized DNL-1021 before the regimen-specific screening labs came back; they arrived the next day.

subject: DNL-1022 new med
body: DNL-1022 is at Week 10 of treatment. His PCP started rifampin last week for latent TB and he is still taking study drug.

subject: DNL-1023
body: At the Week 16 visit DNL-1023 told us she started St. John's wort a month ago for low mood. She is continuing study drug.

subject: Pharmacy fridge room
body: The drug storage room temperature hit 34°C over the weekend when the AC failed. We dispensed kits from that room to DNL-1024 on Monday.

subject: DNL-1025 transplant meds
body: DNL-1025 (Week 6) was started on tacrolimus by his rheumatologist; he remains on study drug.

subject: DNL-1026 Week 4 PK
body: Week 4 for DNL-1026: predose PK drawn at 6:00, he took his dose in clinic at 9:30, postdose PK at 12:00.

subject: DNL-1027 PK
body: DNL-1027 Week 4: predose PK at 8:00, dose at 8:30, postdose PK not drawn until 18:45 because the lab closed early.

subject: DNL-1028 Week 24 PK
body: Week 24 PK for DNL-1028: predose at 7:45, dose at 8:15, postdose at 8:45 so he could leave early.

subject: DNL-1029 screening
body: We drew screening labs and did the vital capacity for DNL-1029 on Monday; he signed the consent form on Wednesday.

subject: DNL-1030 ICF
body: The IRB approved consent version 4 last month. We have not re-consented DNL-1030 yet and did his Week 16 visit today.

subject: DNL-1031 fall
body: DNL-1031 fell at home and fractured her wrist; she was admitted overnight. Not sure if related.

subject: DNL-1032 symptoms
body: DNL-1032 reports headaches and some nausea since starting study drug last week.

subject: DNL-1033 randomized
body: DNL-1033 randomized today. Screening: eGFR 34, ALT 1.2x ULN, SVC 62% predicted. First dose in clinic after all baseline procedures.

subject: DNL-1034 history
body: DNL-1034 randomized Monday; he had a basal cell carcinoma removed from his nose last year.

subject: DNL-1035 meds
body: DNL-1035 randomized. Stable on riluzole for 6 months and has completed two cycles of edaravone.

subject: DNL-1036 Week 4
body: Week 4 visit for DNL-1036 was on Day 33. PK predose at 8:00, dose 8:45, postdose 11:00.

subject: DNL-1037 Week 16
body: DNL-1037 Week 16 visit done on Day 108, all assessments completed.

subject: DNL-1038 PK
body: DNL-1038 Week 24: predose PK 1 hour before the in-clinic dose, postdose at 3 hours. CSF collected before the first ATE dose.

subject: Monitoring visit
body: Hi team, the monitoring visit is next Tuesday at 10. Please have the regulatory binder and drug accountability logs ready.

subject: DNL-1040 labs
body: Labs for DNL-1040 a bit off this time, but the PI reviewed and says all within normal range. No action.

subject: screening chem
body: DNL-1041 randomized this am. eGFR came back 29.5, creat 2.1. PI ok'd it since he 'looks well'.
note: eGFR must be 30 or more; 29.5 is just under

subject: DNL-1042 rando
body: Randomized DNL-1042. AST 125 (ULN 40), ALT 88. Otherwise unremarkable.

subject: DNL-1043 edaravone
body: DNL-1043 randomized today. He just started his first edaravone cycle last Monday, so he is partway through it.
note: must have completed at least one edaravone cycle before screening

subject: DNL-1044 onc hx
body: Hi, DNL-1044 randomized Thurs. PMH: colon cancer, resected 18 months ago, clear scans since.
note: cancer must be curatively treated with no recurrence for at least 3 years

subject: DNL-1045
body: DNL-1045 randomized. He told us he will not use any contraception during the study; his partner is 34.
note: men must agree to effective contraception

subject: Weekly update
body: Weekly update: 3 screened, 2 randomized (DNL-1046, DNL-1047). DNL-1046 had a seizure in August (about 2 months ago), neuro saw her. DNL-1047 all fine.
note: seizure within 6 months of randomization, buried in a weekly update

subject: DNL-1048 meds
body: DNL-1048 dosed today. Recent med rec: phenytoin stopped 6 days before first dose (seizure prophylaxis after an old head injury).
note: strong CYP3A4 inducer must be stopped at least 2 weeks before first dose; also no seizure info so eligibility only

subject: Re: DNL-1049 labs
body: Thanks. Yes DNL-1049 is randomized now. One thing I forgot to mention: he's in the observational arm of another ALS drug study and got his last dose of that drug 10 days ago.
note: investigational treatment within 30 days of screening

subject: DNL-1050 W8
body: DNL-1050 Week 8 visit done on Day 66, all procedures done.

subject: DNL-1051 W16
body: Week 16 for DNL-1051 was on Day 121, he had a cold the week before.
note: Week 16 window is Day 105-119; a cold during the study is also an adverse event

subject: DNL-1052 screening
body: DNL-1052 baseline today (Day 0). His master screening visit was 50 days ago; we were waiting on the regimen slot.
note: screening must be within 42 days before baseline

subject: DNL-1053 ATE
body: DNL-1053 rolled into the ATE. His Week 4 ATE visit was 40 days after his Week 24 visit.
note: Week 4 ATE window is 21-35 days after Week 24

subject: DNL-1054 phone
body: We were not able to do the Week 12 telephone visit for DNL-1054 at all; next contact will be Week 16.

subject: DNL-1055 LP
body: DNL-1055: baseline LP on 9/30, first dose of study drug 10/9.
note: baseline CSF must be within one week before the first dose; 9 days

subject: DNL-1056 baseline
body: Baseline for DNL-1056: first dose given at 9:00 in clinic, then the ECG and the blood draw at 9:30.
note: first dose only after all baseline procedures

subject: DNL-1057 Week 24
body: DNL-1057 finished Week 24 and got his ATE kit. He took the first open-label dose at home that evening; his Week 24 LP is booked for next Tuesday.
note: Week 24 CSF must be collected before the first ATE dose

subject: DNL-1058 randomized
body: We randomized DNL-1058 on Monday; the regimen-specific eligibility review by the PI was signed off on Wednesday.
note: randomization only after eligibility is confirmed

subject: DNL-1059 dosing
body: DNL-1059 forgot his dose yesterday so this morning he took yesterday's packet and today's packet together.
note: only one dose per day; a missed dose remembered next day is skipped

subject: DNL-1060 W4 dosing
body: Week 4 for DNL-1060: I gave the dose myself at 9:10; nobody else was free to double-check the kit and ID, it was a busy morning.
note: dose and ID must be confirmed by a second staff member

subject: DNL-1061 accountability
body: DNL-1061 Week 8 visit done. We forgot to count his returned packets and he took them home again.
note: unused packets must be counted at each clinic visit

subject: DNL-1062
body: DNL-1062 has trouble with the drink; it took her about 40 minutes to finish this morning's dose at the clinic.
note: all dosing should be completed within 15 minutes

subject: DNL-1063 new med
body: Neurology started DNL-1063 on phenytoin last week after a fall; he is still taking study drug.
note: phenytoin is a strong CYP3A4 inducer, prohibited during treatment

subject: DNL-1064 conmeds
body: Conmed update for DNL-1064 (Week 14): added St John's wort tea daily for sleep, and melatonin. No other changes.
note: St John's wort is a strong inducer, prohibited

subject: DNL-1065 PK
body: DNL-1065 Week 4: predose PK drawn 2.5 hours before his dose; postdose 2 hours after.
note: predose must be 0-2 hours before the dose

subject: DNL-1066 W24 PK
body: Week 24 PK DNL-1066: pre 07:50, dose 08:20, post 17:30.
note: postdose must be 1-8 hours after the dose; this is 9h10

subject: DNL-1067 Week 4
body: DNL-1067 Week 4 went fine. Predose PK at 8:15, dose 8:40, and we grabbed the postdose tube at 9:20 before he left.

subject: DNL-1068 ICF
body: Heads up: I consented DNL-1068 on the version 3 form this morning, then saw version 4 was approved two weeks ago.
note: only the current IRB-approved form may be used

subject: DNL-1069 screening
body: DNL-1069 came in early so we did the ECG and vitals while waiting for the PI; he signed consent after lunch.

subject: DNL-1070 admitted
body: DNL-1070 was admitted Sunday with pneumonia, still inpatient. Will send SAE form.

subject: DNL-1071 rash
body: DNL-1071 called: itchy rash on both arms since Tuesday, two days after Week 4.

subject: DNL-1072
body: Sad news, DNL-1072 passed away at home on Saturday. Family will call us with details.

subject: DNL-1073 fall
body: DNL-1073 had a fall at home, no injury, didn't go to the ER. Mentioned at today's call.

subject: DNL-1074 W8
body: DNL-1074 had bad headaches all week so his Week 8 visit ended up on Day 70.
note: a safety report plus a visit outside Day 49-63

subject: DNL-1075 rando
body: DNL-1075 randomized. SVC exactly 50% predicted at screening, eGFR 30, AST 2.9x ULN.
note: all at the limit but allowed

subject: DNL-1076 onset
body: DNL-1076 randomized today; weakness started about 23 months before his screening visit.

subject: DNL-1077 history
body: DNL-1077 randomized. He had a melanoma removed 4 years ago, no recurrence.

subject: DNL-1078 history
body: DNL-1078: prostatic carcinoma in situ diagnosed in 2024, watchful waiting. Randomized Monday.
note: carcinoma in situ of the prostate is allowed

subject: DNL-1079 dosing
body: DNL-1079 gets his study drug through his feeding tube now; went fine at Week 16.
note: oral or feeding tube is allowed

subject: DNL-1080 missed dose
body: DNL-1080 missed Tuesday's dose and only remembered Wednesday, so he just took Wednesday's dose as normal.
note: this is what the protocol says to do

subject: DNL-1081 DNA
body: Baseline DNA tube for DNL-1081 hemolyzed, so we redrew DNA at Week 4.
note: DNA can be collected after baseline if the baseline sample is not usable

subject: DNL-1082 W2
body: Week 2 call for DNL-1082 done on Day 12, compliance check done.

subject: DNL-1083 safety call
body: Follow-up safety call for DNL-1083 done 27 days after last dose.

subject: DNL-1084 LP
body: DNL-1084: baseline LP Monday, first dose of study drug Thursday after all baseline procedures.
note: CSF 3 days before first dose is allowed

subject: DNL-1085 re-screen
body: DNL-1085 failed SVC in July (47%), re-screened this month after the required interval at 53% and was randomized.

subject: Question
body: Quick question for the CRA: if someone's eGFR comes back 28 at screening, can we repeat it before deciding?

subject: DNL-1087 screen fail
body: We were about to randomize DNL-1087 when I noticed his ALT was 4x ULN. Screen failed him, nothing given.

subject: Old deviation
body: FYI for the file: back in 2024 at our old site one participant was dosed before consent; that was reported and closed then.

subject: DNL-1089 ALSFRS
body: DNL-1089's ALSFRS-R dropped 3 points since Week 8, PI aware.
note: disease progression, not a protocol problem

subject: DNL-1090 W24 done
body: Great news, DNL-1090 completed Week 24 on Day 166 with all assessments and CSF, and is starting ATE.

body: Clinic is closed Monday for the holiday; we will reschedule any affected visits within their windows.

body: Annual IRB continuing review approved yesterday, letter attached to the regulatory binder.

subject: Kit shipment
body: Received 12 DNL343 kits today, temp logger fine, logged in IRT.

body: Query 4471 answered: the ECG time was a typo, corrected in EDC.

body: Reminder: the new coordinators need GCP refresher training by end of month.

body: I am out of the office until Monday with limited access to email.

body: We have 5 people in pre-screening for Regimen G, 2 look promising.

body: Parking garage B is closed next week; tell participants to use garage C.

body: DNL-1099 Week 16 ECG normal, vitals stable, ALSFRS-R stable.

subject: DNL-1100 labs
body: DNL-1100's potassium a little low this time, PI reviewed, not clinically significant.
note: vague lab note, no study limit broken

body: Randomized DNL-1092 today. Background for the file: in the earlier DNL343 Phase 1b study he broke out in hives after the drug and was taken off it.
